job.title: Personal Assistant
job.description:
Executive Personal Assistant
Employment Type: Full-time
 
Our Client is seeking an exceptionally organized, discreet, and proactive Personal Assistant to provide comprehensive support to a private household and its family. This role combines personal assistance, household coordination, staff supervision, transportation scheduling, travel planning, and private aviation support.

The successful candidate will ensure that the household operates smoothly, efficiently, and to a consistently high standard. Responsibilities include managing calendars and appointments, coordinating household employees and drivers, overseeing vendors and service providers, arranging travel and private jet logistics, managing household records and expenses, and anticipating the needs of the principal and family.

This position requires sound judgment, absolute confidentiality, excellent communication skills, flexibility, and the ability to manage multiple priorities without constant supervision.

Core Responsibilities Personal and Executive Support
  • Manage personal and professional calendars, appointments, meetings, school schedules, social commitments, and family activities.

  • Coordinate daily schedules for the principal and family members.

  • Prepare daily itineraries, briefing notes, reminders, and schedules.

  • Screen and manage calls, emails, messages, invitations, and correspondence.

  • Draft letters, emails, notes, reports, schedules, and other documents.

  • Organize personal appointments, including medical, dental, wellness, fitness, salon, and other services.

  • Maintain confidential contact lists, personal records, memberships, subscriptions, and important dates.

  • Coordinate gifts, flowers, cards, thank-you notes, celebrations, and special occasions.

  • Conduct research and complete personal, household, travel, and administrative projects.

  • Anticipate upcoming needs and resolve routine issues before they become problems.

Household Management
  • Coordinate the daily operation and administration of the household. Manage a team of security guards, helpers, gardeners, drivers etc.

  • Maintain household calendars, task lists, maintenance schedules, inventories, and operating procedures.

  • Monitor the condition, cleanliness, organization, and presentation of the residence.

  • Coordinate regular and deep cleaning, laundry, ironing, wardrobe care, linens, and seasonal household tasks.

  • Arrange maintenance, repairs, inspections, renovations, landscaping, pest control, security, technology support, and other property services.

  • Obtain estimates, compare vendors, schedule appointments, monitor work, and confirm satisfactory completion.

  • Maintain records of warranties, manuals, service agreements, property documents, and maintenance history.

  • Manage household deliveries, packages, mail, returns, storage, and shipping.

  • Maintain inventories of food, beverages, toiletries, cleaning supplies, office supplies, medications, and other household essentials.

  • Coordinate grocery shopping, meal planning, catering, private chefs, restaurants, and special dietary requirements.

  • Arrange household preparations before and after the principal’s arrival, departure, or travel.

  • Prepare guest rooms, residences, vehicles, and entertaining areas for visitors and events.

  • Coordinate seasonal preparations, including holiday decorations, winterization, pool opening and closing, and storm or emergency readiness.

  • Support the management of multiple residences, if applicable.

Management of Household Staff and Helpers
  • Coordinate schedules and daily assignments for housekeepers, nannies, chefs, caregivers, gardeners, estate workers, security personnel, and other household employees.

  • Maintain staff calendars, contact information, work schedules, leave requests, and coverage plans.

  • Prepare weekly staff schedules and adjust them for travel, events, holidays, illness, and changing household needs.

  • Delegate tasks clearly and follow up to ensure completion.

  • Coordinate staff meetings, handovers, briefings, and household communications.

  • Establish and maintain household standards, routines, checklists, and service expectations.

  • Assist with recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, training, and orientation of household employees and contractors.

  • Maintain personnel records, timesheets, payroll information, certifications, and employment documentation as directed.

  • Coordinate substitute or temporary staff when regular employees are unavailable.

  • Help resolve scheduling conflicts and routine staff concerns professionally.

  • Maintain appropriate professional boundaries and protect the privacy of the principal and family.

  • Report significant performance, safety, conduct, or staffing concerns to the employer or family office manager.

Driver and Transportation Coordination
  • Create and manage driver schedules for the principal, family members, guests, and household staff.

  • Coordinate school runs, airport transfers, appointments, meetings, events, shopping, and personal transportation.

  • Arrange backup drivers and alternative transportation when needed.

Private Jet and Aviation Support
  • Coordinate private aviation arrangements with the principal’s aviation department, flight department, aircraft management company, charter provider, broker, or family office.

  • Maintain and update passenger profiles, travel preferences, passport information, frequent-flyer details, emergency contacts, and required travel documentation.

  • Prepare and distribute flight itineraries, passenger manifests, ground transportation details, hotel information, and destination schedules.

  • Coordinate passenger availability, departure times, aircraft catering, special meals, luggage requirements, pets, medical equipment, and other onboard preferences.

  • Arrange airport transfers, drivers, security, accommodation, meeting schedules, and local logistics at each destination.

  • Confirm flight details, departure locations, arrival times, aircraft changes, passenger requirements, and ground-service arrangements.

Travel and Trip Management
  • Plan and coordinate domestic and international travel from start to finish.

  • Prepare detailed travel itineraries covering flights, private aviation, hotels, residences, transportation, dining, meetings, activities, and contingency plans.

  • Coordinate packing lists, luggage, wardrobe requirements, medication, documents, gifts, equipment, and personal items.

  • Arrange visas, travel insurance, airport services, security, interpreters, guides, reservations, and local support.

  • Prepare residences and household staff for the principal’s departure and return.

Events, Entertaining, and Guest Services
  • Plan and coordinate private dinners, parties, family celebrations, business functions, holidays, and special events.

  • Manage guest lists, invitations, RSVPs, seating arrangements, menus, décor, entertainment, rentals, flowers, staffing, and transportation.

  • Coordinate caterers, chefs, servers, bartenders, event planners, florists, musicians, photographers, and other vendors.

  • Prepare guest information, dietary notes, arrival instructions, accommodations, and transportation plans.

  • Ensure the residence is prepared before events and restored afterward.

  • Coordinate gifts, welcome amenities, guest rooms, and personalized arrangements for visitors.

Financial and Administrative Responsibilities
  • Track household expenses, invoices, receipts, reimbursements, subscriptions, memberships, and recurring payments.

  • Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems.

  • Prepare expense reports and payment summaries for review and approval.

  • Monitor household budgets and identify unusual charges or upcoming expenses.

  • Coordinate with accountants, bookkeepers, attorneys, insurance representatives, property managers, and family office personnel.

  • Maintain records for household purchases, repairs, travel, vehicles, staff expenses, and vendor payments.

  • Reconcile receipts and confirm that invoices match agreed services and pricing.

  • Handle petty cash and approved purchases in accordance with household procedures.

  • Protect financial information and never disclose private spending, assets, travel, or family information.

Security, Safety, and Confidentiality
  • Maintain complete confidentiality regarding the principal, family, residence, travel, finances, guests, staff, and personal affairs.

  • Follow household security procedures for visitors, deliveries, contractors, keys, access codes, alarms, and sensitive documents.

  • Maintain emergency contact lists and assist with household emergency-preparedness procedures.

  • Report safety hazards, suspicious activity, property damage, accidents, or security concerns immediately.

Required Qualifications
  • Several years of experience as a personal assistant, executive assistant, household manager, estate manager, family assistant, chief of staff, or in a comparable private-service role.

  • Experience supporting a private household, high-profile individual, executive, family office, or multiple-property residence.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating household staff, drivers, vendors, travel, or complex schedules.

  • Exceptional organizational, time-management, and follow-through skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
